a: Sunbeams' fade mask stops at the 0..100 viewBox, so beams vanish from any part of the outline that bloat or an outward effect pushes past the box
Sheen, and the Aqua and Metal gloss, paint a fixed 0..100 rect, so a body that reaches past the box gets none on those parts
Sunbeams' `gradientAngle` is in stretched viewBox space while its `angle` is corrected to CSS space
Woodgrain's knot "circles" are sized in viewBox units, so they squash to slivers on a wide badge
A negative spike `length` throws spikes outward on tight corners and nowhere else
The perforations effect ignores `phase`, so its holes don't crawl when the badge's other perimeter patterns do
Rivets sit at the box's corners whatever the base, so on a non-rectangular outline they float outside the badge
b: A sunbeams `count` or woodgrain `lines`/`knots` of Infinity hangs the render; a huge one stalls it
`NaN` in a bump effect's params turns the whole composed outline into `NaN` path data
A perforations hole is painted over by every foreground effect, so it vanishes under aqua, metal, bevel, sheen or sunbeams
The sunbeams fade's `gradientAngle` is in viewBox units while the beams' `angle` is in CSS degrees, so a diagonal fade comes out at the wrong angle
Sheen, sunbeams and the aqua/metal gloss stop at the 0..100 viewBox, leaving spike and puff tips that cross it undecorated
Sheen looks `lightFrom` up on a plain object, so `'constructor'`/`'toString'` reach the prototype
